name: Flat Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with feet planted and shoulder blades pulled back and down. Start with dumbbells over your chest, then lower them under control until they're level with your chest and you feel a stretch. Press back up in a slight arc until the dumbbells are over your chest again.

name: Flat Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with eyes under the bar, feet planted and shoulder blades retracted. Grip slightly wider than shoulder width, unrack, and lower the bar under control to your mid-chest with elbows tucked about 45-60°. Press back up to lockout over your shoulders.

name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Set the bench to about 30°. Kick the dumbbells up one at a time, retract your shoulder blades and start with the weights over your upper chest. Lower under control to upper-chest level for a deep stretch, then press back up and slightly in.

name: Low Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Set the bench to 15-30°. With shoulder blades retracted, lower the dumbbells under control to chest level, then press back up over your upper chest. The low angle hits the upper chest while keeping the shoulders comfortable.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Set the bench to 30-45° and grip slightly wider than shoulder width. Unrack, lower the bar under control to your upper chest just below the collarbone, then press straight back up to lockout.

name: Incline Smith Machine Press
instructions: Set a bench at about 30° under the Smith bar so it lines up with your upper chest. Grip just outside shoulder width, unhook, and lower under control to your upper chest. Press back up without locking out hard.

name: Low Incline Smith Machine Press
aliases: Low Incline Smith Press (Incline set 15-30 degrees)
instructions: Set the bench to 15-30° under the Smith bar. Lower the bar under control to your upper/mid chest with elbows slightly tucked, then press back up.

name: Flat Smith Machine Press
instructions: Place a flat bench under the Smith bar so it lines up with your mid-chest. Retract your shoulder blades, unhook, lower the bar under control to your chest, then press back up.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your mid-chest. Sit with your back flat against the pad and shoulder blades pulled back. Press the handles forward until your arms are nearly straight, then return slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.

name: Incline Chest Press Machine
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your upper chest. Keep your back on the pad and shoulder blades retracted. Press up and forward, then return slowly to a full stretch.

name: Pec Deck
instructions: Adjust the seat so your upper arms are about shoulder height. With a slight bend in the elbows, bring the handles together in a wide arc in front of your chest and squeeze. Return slowly until you feel a deep stretch across the chest.

name: Cable Chest Fly
instructions: Set both cables around shoulder height and stand in the middle with a staggered stance. With a slight bend in the elbows, bring the handles together in front of your chest in a hugging motion. Return slowly to a full stretch.

name: Dumbbell Chest Fly
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells over your chest, palms facing each other. Keeping a slight bend in the elbows, lower the weights out to the sides until you feel a stretch in the chest. Bring them back together over your chest.

name: Low to High Cable Fly
cuesFrom: Single Arm Low to High Cable Fly
aliases: Single Arm Low to High Cable Fly
instructions: Set the cables low (around waist height or below). With a staggered stance and slight elbow bend, sweep the handles up and together to about chin height, squeezing the upper chest. Lower slowly back to the start. Can be done one arm at a time.

name: High to Low Cable Fly
instructions: Set the cables above head height. Step forward into a staggered stance and, with a slight elbow bend, sweep the handles down and together in front of your lower chest. Return slowly to a full stretch.

name: Chest Dip
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with arms straight. Lean your torso forward and lower yourself until your shoulders are slightly below your elbows and you feel a chest stretch. Press back up to the top.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Start in a plank with hands slightly wider than shoulders and body in a straight line. Lower your chest to just above the floor with elbows at about 45°, then press back up.

name: Wide Grip Lat Pulldown
aliases: Wide Grip Lat Pulldown Strict Form
instructions: Grip the bar outside shoulder width and lock your thighs under the pad. With a slight lean back, pull the elbows down toward your sides until the bar reaches your upper chest. Control the bar back up to a full stretch.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit with thighs locked under the pad and grip the bar about shoulder width. Keeping your torso and pelvis aligned, pull your elbows down to your sides until the bar reaches your upper chest. Return slowly to a full stretch overhead.

name: Neutral Grip Lat Pulldown
aliases: Neutral Grip Lat Pulldown Strict Form
instructions: Attach a neutral-grip (palms facing) handle. Sit with thighs locked in, pull your elbows down and in toward your hips, bringing the handle to your upper chest. Control it back up to a full stretch.

name: Single Arm Lat Pulldown
instructions: Use a single D handle. Sit slightly angled toward the working side and pull your elbow down in front of you toward your hip, squeezing the lat. Let the arm rise all the way back up for a full stretch.

name: Single Arm Underhand Lat Pulldown
instructions: Grip a single D handle with your palm facing you. Pull your elbow down toward your hip, keeping it close to your body, then let it rise back up to a full stretch.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with hands just outside shoulder width. Pull your shoulder blades down, then drive your elbows down toward your sides until your chin clears the bar. Lower under control to a full hang.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with palms facing you about shoulder width apart. Pull your elbows down to your sides until your chin clears the bar, then lower under control to a full hang.

name: Assisted Pull-Up
instructions: Kneel or stand on the assistance pad and grip the handles just outside shoulder width. Pull your elbows down to your sides until your chin clears the handles, then lower under control. Use less assistance as you get stronger.

name: Lower Lat Biased Cable Row
cuesFrom: Lower Lat Biased Cable Row (Double D Handle)
aliases: Cable Lower Lat Biased Row (D handle)
Lower Lat Biased Cable Row (Double D Handle)
Lower Lat Biased Row (pull tight to hip/belly button)
Lower Lat biased cable row (neutral grip handle, pull tight to hip)
instructions: Sit facing the cable with a neutral-grip (double D) handle. With a slight forward lean, pull your elbows back tight to your sides toward your hips/belly button. Let the handle travel forward slowly for a full lat stretch.

name: Single Arm Lower Lat Biased Cable Row
cuesFrom: Single Arm Lower Lat Biased Cable Row
aliases: Single Arm Cable Lower Lat Biased Row
Single Arm Cable Lower Lat Biased Row (pull tight to hip/belly button)
Single arm lower lat biased cable row (neutral grip, pull tight to hip)
instructions: Sit facing the cable with a single D handle. Pull your elbow back and down tight to your hip, keeping your torso still. Reach forward slowly to a full stretch before the next rep.

name: Chest Supported Upper Back Row
aliases: Chest Supported Upper Back Row Machine
Upper back elbows flared chest supported row
instructions: Set the chest pad so you can reach the handles at full stretch. Keep your chest on the pad and pull with elbows flared out about 75-90°, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Return slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Dumbbell Chest Supported Upper Back Row
cuesFrom: Dumbbell Chest Supported Upper Back Row (chest on bench)
aliases: Dumbbell Chest Supported Upper Back Row (chest on bench)
Dumbbell Chest Supported Upper Back Row (elbows flared)
Chest-supported upper back Dumbbell Row (Elbows flared)
instructions: Set a bench to 45-60° and lie chest-down on it with dumbbells hanging. Row the weights up with elbows flared out wide, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Lower slowly to a full stretch.

name: Chest Supported Cable Upper Back Row
aliases: Chest supported cable upper back row (elbows flared)
instructions: Place a bench facing the cable and rest your chest against it. Using a wide grip, row with elbows flared out to the sides, squeezing your upper back. Return slowly to a full stretch.

name: Upper Back Cable Row
instructions: Set the cable around chest height and use a wide grip. Sit tall and row the handle toward your upper chest with elbows flared out, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Return slowly.

name: Single Arm Upper Back Cable Row
cuesFrom: Upper Back Cable Single Arm Row
aliases: Upper Back Cable Single Arm Row
instructions: Use a single handle set around chest height. Row with your elbow flared out 75-90° from your side, squeezing your upper back, then reach forward slowly to a full stretch.

name: Upper Back Barbell Row
cuesFrom: Upper Back Biased Barbell Row (elbows flared, bar comes up to chest)
aliases: Upper Back Biased Barbell Row (elbows flared, bar comes up to chest)
instructions: Hinge forward until your chest is close to parallel with the floor, back flat. Using a wide grip, row the bar up to your lower chest with elbows flared out, then lower under control.

name: Single Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Place one knee and the same-side hand on a bench, back flat. Row the dumbbell back toward your hip, keeping your elbow close to your body. Lower slowly to a full stretch.

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Stand or lie chest-supported on the T-bar station. Keeping your back flat, row the handle toward your stomach, squeezing your back at the top. Lower under control to a full stretch.

name: Straight Arm Cable Pulldown
instructions: Set the cable high with a straight bar or rope. Hinge slightly forward with arms nearly straight and sweep the handle down to your thighs using your lats. Return slowly overhead.

name: Low Back Extension
instructions: Set the pad just below your hip crease with feet secured. Lower your torso under control, then raise it until your body forms a straight line. Avoid over-arching at the top.

name: Glute Biased Back Extension
instructions: Set the pad at your hips with feet turned slightly out. Round your upper back slightly and hinge down, then squeeze your glutes to drive your hips into the pad and raise your torso.

name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with mid-foot under the bar and grip just outside your legs. Brace, flatten your back and push the floor away to stand up, keeping the bar close to your body. Hinge back down under control.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides. Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears, pause, then lower slowly to a full stretch.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on a bench set upright with your back supported. Start with dumbbells at about ear height, palms forward. Press up until your arms are nearly straight, then lower under control.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles start around ear/jaw height. Keep your back on the pad and press up until your arms are nearly straight. Lower slowly back to the start.

name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Place an upright bench under the Smith bar so it comes down in front of your face. Press the bar up to just short of lockout, then lower under control to about chin height.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with the bar on your front shoulders, grip just outside shoulder width. Brace your core and glutes, press the bar overhead, moving your head back slightly to clear it. Lower under control.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand tall with a soft bend in the elbows. Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until they reach about shoulder height, leading with the elbows. Lower slowly.

name: Seated Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Sit tall on a bench. With a soft bend in the elbows, raise the dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height, then lower slowly. Sitting removes momentum.

name: Single Arm Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Hold a support with your free hand and lean slightly away. Raise the dumbbell out to the side to shoulder height with a soft elbow bend, then lower slowly.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Set the cable low and stand side-on, holding the handle across your body. Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height, leading with the elbow. Lower slowly.

name: Machine Lateral Raise
instructions: Adjust the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine's pivot. With arms against the pads, raise them out to the sides to shoulder height, then lower slowly.

name: Single Arm Machine Lateral Raise
instructions: Adjust the seat so your elbow sits comfortably against the pad. Raise one arm out to the side to shoulder height, then lower slowly.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
cuesFrom: Rear Delt Fly Reverse Pec Dec
aliases: Rear Delt Fly Reverse Pec Dec
Reverse Rear Delt Fly Pec Dec
instructions: Sit facing the pad with handles at shoulder height. With a slight elbow bend, sweep your arms back and out until they're in line with your body, squeezing the rear delts. Return slowly.

name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and dumbbells hanging. With a slight elbow bend, raise the weights out to the sides, squeezing the rear delts. Lower slowly.

name: Single Arm Cable Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Set the cable at shoulder height and grab it with the opposite hand. Sweep your arm across and back until it's in line with your body, then return slowly.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Set a rope at upper-chest height. Pull the rope toward your face, separating the ends and driving your elbows out and back. Return slowly.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs. Raise them straight in front of you to shoulder height with a soft elbow bend, then lower slowly.

name: EZ Bar Curl
instructions: Grip the EZ bar on the angled portions and stand tall with elbows at your sides. Curl the bar up without letting your elbows drift forward, squeeze, then lower slowly to full extension.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand tall gripping a straight bar about shoulder width, palms up. Curl the bar up keeping your elbows pinned, squeeze, then lower slowly to full extension.

name: EZ Bar Cable Curl
instructions: Set the cable all the way down with an EZ bar attachment. Grip the angled portions, keep elbows at your sides and curl up. Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Cable Curl
instructions: Set the cable at the floor with a straight bar. Stand tall with elbows at your sides and curl the bar up, squeezing at the top. Lower slowly.

name: Single Arm Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Stand tall with the elbow at your side. Curl the dumbbell up, rotating your palm to face up as you go, squeeze, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other. Keeping elbows pinned at your sides, curl the weights up, then lower slowly.

name: Rope Hammer Curl
instructions: Set the cable at the floor with a rope. Grip with palms facing each other and curl the rope up with elbows at your sides. Lower slowly.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Sit back on a bench set to 45-60° with arms hanging straight down. Curl the dumbbells up without moving your upper arms, then lower slowly to a full stretch.

name: Preacher Curl Machine
instructions: Sit with your armpits tucked against the top of the pad. Curl the handles up, squeeze, then lower slowly until your arms are almost fully straight.

name: Single Arm Preacher Curl Machine
instructions: Sit with your armpit tucked against the pad. Curl one handle up, squeeze, then lower slowly to almost full extension.

name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
aliases: Single Arm Dumbbell Preacher Bicep Curl
instructions: Rest the back of your upper arm flat on the preacher pad. Curl the dumbbell up, squeeze, then lower slowly until your arm is almost straight.

name: Incline Curl Machine
instructions: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest flat on the pad with elbows aligned to the pivot. Curl up, squeeze, then lower slowly.

name: Bayesian Cable Curl
instructions: Set a cable low and face away from it, holding the handle with your arm slightly behind your body. Curl forward and up while keeping your elbow back, then lower slowly to a full stretch.

name: EZ Bar Reverse Curl
instructions: Grip the EZ bar palms down. Keeping elbows at your sides, curl the bar up, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
instructions: Rest your forearms on your thighs or a bench with palms up and wrists hanging off. Curl the dumbbells up by flexing your wrists, then lower slowly.

name: Rope Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Set the cable high with a rope (or cuffs). Keep your elbows pinned at your sides and press down until your arms are straight, spreading the rope at the bottom. Return slowly until your forearms pass parallel.

name: EZ Bar Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Set the cable high with an EZ bar. Grip the angled portions, pin your elbows and press down to full lockout. Return slowly.

name: V Bar Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Set the cable high and grip the V-bar with palms facing in. Keep your elbows at your sides and press down to lockout, then return slowly.

name: Single Arm Overhand Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Set the cable high with a single handle, palm facing down. Pin your elbow at your side and press down to lockout, then return slowly.

name: Single Arm Cable Tricep Extension
instructions: Set the cable at the top with a single handle. Keep your elbow pinned at your side and extend your arm fully, then return slowly.

name: Overhead Cable Tricep Extension (V Bar)
instructions: Set the cable around waist height with a V-bar and turn away from the machine. With elbows up beside your head, extend your arms forward and overhead, then return slowly to a deep stretch.

name: Overhead Rope Tricep Extension
instructions: Set the cable low or mid with a rope and face away. With elbows up beside your head, extend overhead until your arms are straight, then lower slowly behind your head.

name: Overhead Dumbbell Tricep Extension
instructions: Sit on an upright bench holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands cupping the top. Lower it behind your head keeping elbows pointed up, then extend back to the top.

name: EZ Bar Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Sit or stand with the EZ bar overhead, gripping the angled portions. Lower it behind your head with elbows pointing up, then extend back up.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension Machine
instructions: Adjust the seat so your elbows start bent at about 90° with upper arms on the pad. Extend until your arms are straight, then return slowly.

name: EZ Bar Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding the EZ bar over your shoulders. Bend only at the elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead or just behind your head, then extend back up.

name: Tricep Dip Machine
instructions: Sit upright and grip the handles at your sides. Press down until your arms are straight, keeping your torso upright, then return slowly.

name: Close Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and grip the bar about shoulder width. Lower it to your lower chest with elbows tucked close to your body, then press back up.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with feet about shoulder width. Brace, then sit down between your heels keeping your chest up until your thighs are at least parallel. Drive back up through your whole foot.

name: Smith Machine Squat
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back with feet slightly in front of you. Squat down under control until thighs are at or below parallel, then drive back up.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Set your back against the pad and shoulders under the pads, feet about shoulder width in the middle of the platform. Lower under control as deep as you can with heels down, then press back up.

name: Pendulum Squat
instructions: Set your back against the pad with shoulders under the pads. Lower under control into a deep squat, then drive back up through your mid-foot.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit with your back flat against the pad and feet in the middle to lower part of the platform. Lower the sled under control until your knees are deeply bent, then press back up without locking out hard.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Adjust the seat so your knees line up with the machine's pivot and the pad sits on your lower shins. Extend your legs until straight, squeeze your quads, then lower slowly.

name: Single Leg Extension
instructions: Set up as for a leg extension and work one leg at a time. Extend until straight, squeeze, and lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest. With feet about shoulder width, squat down between your heels keeping your chest up, then drive back up.

name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a kettlebell close to your chest by the horns. Squat down until thighs are at least parallel, chest up, then stand back up.

name: Heel Elevated Dumbbell Squat
aliases: Dumbbell Squat, heels elevated on a 2.5-5lb plate
instructions: Stand with heels raised on small plates, holding dumbbells at your sides. Squat straight down with an upright torso, letting your knees travel forward, then drive up.

name: Landmine Squat
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar at chest level with both hands, feet shoulder width. Squat down keeping your chest up, then drive back up.

name: Landmine Sumo Squat
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar at chest level with a wide stance and toes turned out. Squat down keeping your knees out over your toes, then drive back up.

name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Place your rear foot laces-down on a bench behind you, holding dumbbells at your sides. Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel, then drive up through your front foot. Complete all reps, then switch legs.

name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides. Step forward into a lunge until your back knee nearly touches the floor, then drive through the front foot and step into the next rep.

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and place one foot on a box or bench. Drive through that foot to stand up on the box, then lower slowly back down. Finish one side before switching.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
aliases: Barbell or Dumbbell RDL/SLDL (go light to start, focus on keeping back straight and having good form)
instructions: Stand holding the bar in front of your thighs. With a slight knee bend, push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs, keeping your back flat, until you feel a deep hamstring stretch. Drive your hips forward to stand back up.

name: Barbell Stiff Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding the bar with legs almost straight. Hinge at the hips with a flat back, lowering the bar until your chest is about parallel to the floor, then return to standing.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs. With soft knees, push your hips back and lower the weights along your legs until you feel a deep hamstring stretch. Drive your hips forward to stand.

name: Smith Machine RDL
instructions: Stand close to the Smith bar holding it in front of your thighs. Hinge at the hips, dragging the bar along your legs, until you feel a deep hamstring stretch. Drive your hips forward to stand.

name: Single Leg Kettlebell RDL
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in the hand opposite your standing leg. Hinge forward, letting your free leg extend behind you, until you feel a stretch in the standing hamstring. Return to standing and repeat, then switch sides.

name: Seated Hamstring Curl
instructions: Adjust the machine so your knees line up with the pivot and the pad sits on your lower calves. Lock the thigh pad down, curl your heels down and back as far as possible, then return slowly.

name: Lying Hamstring Curl
instructions: Lie face down with the pad just above your heels and knees just off the bench. Keep your hips down and curl your heels toward your glutes, then lower slowly.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and the bar over your hips. With feet flat and shins vertical at the top, drive your hips up until your body is level from shoulders to knees, squeeze your glutes, then lower.

name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
instructions: Set a bench beside the Smith machine and position the bar over your hips. Drive your hips up to full extension, squeeze your glutes, then lower under control.

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench, knees bent and feet flat, with a dumbbell on your hips. Drive your hips up until level with your knees, squeeze, then lower.

name: Hip Thrust Machine
instructions: Set the pad just above your hip crease with feet about shoulder width. Drive your hips up to full extension, squeeze your glutes, then lower slowly.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low cable. Hinge slightly forward holding the machine and kick your leg back and up by squeezing your glute, without arching your lower back. Return slowly.

name: Hip Abduction Machine
instructions: Sit with your hips and knees lined up with the pads. Push your legs out as wide as possible, pause, then return slowly.

name: Hip Adduction Machine
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and legs open against the pads. Squeeze your legs together, pause, then open slowly back to a full stretch.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on the edge of the platform and heels hanging off. Lower your heels for a deep stretch, pause, then rise as high as possible onto your toes.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit with the pad on your lower thighs and the balls of your feet on the platform. Lower your heels for a full stretch, pause, then press up as high as possible.

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
aliases: Optional: Calf Raises on Leg Press
instructions: Sit in the leg press with legs straight and the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the platform. Let the sled push your toes back for a stretch, then press through the balls of your feet.

name: Cable Rope Crunch
instructions: Kneel facing a high cable holding a rope beside your head. Crunch down by curling your ribs toward your hips, keeping your hips still. Return slowly.

name: Ab Crunch Machine
instructions: Adjust the seat and grab the handles. Crunch forward by curling your torso down, pause, then return slowly.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar. Curl your knees or straight legs up toward your chest by tilting your pelvis, then lower slowly without swinging.

name: Plank
instructions: Rest on your forearms and toes with your body in a straight line. Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes, holding without letting your hips sag.
